messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?

Hi, I need to file a dispute for a charge on my credit card. I stayed at a Marriott hotel but when I got there, they gave me a standard double room instead. I've called the hotel twice and they refuse to help me. I want my money back.

Description: File a formal dispute for a credit card transaction.

Tool: file_credit_card_transaction_dispute_4829
Description: File a formal dispute for a credit card transaction.
Parameters:
  - transaction_id: string (required) - The unique identifier for the transaction being disputed
  - card_action: string (required) - Flag indicating the card's status. Must be one of: 'keep_active' (card remains active, dispute only), 'cancel_and_reissue' (card is being cancelled and replaced). This is for record-keeping only and does NOT order a replacement card.
  - card_last_4_digits: string (required) - Last 4 digits of the credit card number
  - full_name: string (required) - Full legal name of the cardholder
  - user_id: string (required) - The user's unique identifier in the system
  - phone: string (required) - Contact phone number
  - email: string (required) - Contact email address
  - address: string (required) - Contact mailing address
  - contacted_merchant: boolean (required) - Whether the user attempted to resolve the issue with the merchant first
  - purchase_date: string (required) - Date when the purchase was made, format MM/DD/YYYY
  - issue_noticed_date: string (required) - Date when the user noticed the issue, format MM/DD/YYYY
  - dispute_reason: string (required) - Reason for the dispute. Must be one of: 'unauthorized_fraudulent_charge', 'duplicate_charge', 'incorrect_amount', 'goods_services_not_received', 'goods_services_not_as_described', 'canceled_subscription_still_charging', 'refund_never_processed'
  - resolution_requested: string (required) - Resolution being requested. Must be one of: 'full_refund', 'partial_refund'
  - eligible_for_provisional_credit: boolean (required) - Whether the user is eligible for provisional credit
  - partial_refund_amount: number (optional) - Amount requested for partial refund (required only if resolution_requested is 'partial_refund')

Description: File a formal dispute for a debit card transaction under Regulation E. Debit card disputes affect actual bank funds and have different liability rules based on reporting timing.

Tool: file_debit_card_transaction_dispute_6281
Description: File a formal dispute for a debit card transaction under Regulation E. Debit card disputes affect actual bank funds and have different liability rules based on reporting timing.
Parameters:
  - transaction_id: string (required) - The unique identifier for the transaction being disputed
  - account_id: string (required) - The checking account ID linked to the debit card
  - card_id: string (required) - The debit card ID
  - user_id: string (required) - The user's unique identifier in the system
  - dispute_category: string (required) - Category of the dispute. Must be one of: 'unauthorized_transaction', 'atm_cash_discrepancy', 'atm_deposit_not_credited', 'duplicate_charge', 'incorrect_amount', 'goods_services_not_received', 'recurring_charge_after_cancellation', 'card_present_fraud', 'card_not_present_fraud'
  - transaction_date: string (required) - Date when the transaction occurred, format MM/DD/YYYY
  - discovery_date: string (required) - Date when the user first noticed the issue, format MM/DD/YYYY
  - disputed_amount: number (required) - The dollar amount being disputed
  - transaction_type: string (required) - Type of transaction. Must be one of: 'pin_purchase', 'signature_purchase', 'online_purchase', 'atm_withdrawal', 'atm_deposit', 'recurring_payment', 'person_to_person'
  - card_in_possession: boolean (required) - Whether the customer still has their physical debit card in their possession
  - pin_compromised: string (required) - Whether the customer's PIN may have been compromised. Must be one of: 'yes_shared', 'yes_observed', 'no', 'unknown'
  - contacted_merchant: boolean (required) - Whether the user attempted to resolve the issue with the merchant first
  - police_report_filed: boolean (required) - Whether a police report has been filed (recommended for fraud over $500)
  - written_statement_provided: boolean (required) - Whether the customer has provided a written statement describing what happened (required for Reg E provisional credit)
  - provisional_credit_eligible: boolean (required) - Whether the user is eligible for provisional credit based on Debit Card Provisional Credit Guidelines
  - customer_max_liability_amount: number (required) - The maximum dollar amount the customer could be liable for based on Regulation E reporting timing rules and the disputed amount. Use -1 for unlimited liability.
  - card_action: string (required) - Action to take on the card. Must be one of: 'keep_active', 'freeze_pending_investigation', 'close_and_reissue'

I’m sorry that happened — I can help file a formal dispute for that Marriott charge. To proceed I need to verify your identity and collect a few details about the transaction. I’ll only file the dispute after you confirm you want me to.

Please provide the following:

1) Identity verification — supply any TWO of these (required before I access/submit account-specific actions):
- Date of birth (MM/DD/YYYY)
- Email on file
- Phone number on file
- Mailing address on file

2) Transaction details (needed to file the dispute):
- Transaction date (MM/DD/YYYY)
- Transaction amount (USD)
- Last 4 digits of the credit card used
- (Optional) Transaction ID from your statement, if you have it
- When you first noticed the issue (MM/DD/YYYY)
- Confirm merchant name (you mentioned Marriott — please confirm)
- Have you attempted to resolve with the merchant? (You said you called twice — please confirm yes/no)

3) Dispute choices:
- Dispute reason (pick one): goods_services_not_as_described (sounds most appropriate), goods_services_not_received, incorrect_amount, refund_never_processed, etc. — please confirm
- Resolution requested: full_refund or partial_refund (if partial, tell me amount)
- Card action: keep_active (leave card as-is) or cancel_and_reissue (cancel card and issue replacement). Which do you want?

If you confirm the above and give the two identity items, I’ll proceed to file the dispute on your behalf and let you know next steps and whether provisional credit may apply. Would you like me to go ahead once you provide those details?

For identity verification, here are two items:

- Email on file: coffeelover_fati@protonmail.com  
- Phone number on file: 313-555-0246  

Transaction details I have:

- Merchant: Marriott Hotels (yes, that’s the merchant)  
- Amount: around $160 (USD)  
- Transaction date: I don’t have the exact date in front of me right now (it was about two weeks ago)  
- Last 4 digits: I don’t have my card on me, so I can’t confirm the last 4 right now  
- Transaction ID: I don’t have it  
- When I first noticed the issue: today  
- Attempted to resolve with merchant: yes — I called them twice and they refused to help  

Dispute choices:

- Dispute reason: goods_services_not_as_described  
- Resolution requested: full_refund  
- Card action: keep_active (please don’t cancel/reissue; it’s not fraud)  

Yes, please go ahead and file the dispute once you have what you need.
